_doc: PackCraft v2 content. Items: t=rarity tier 0-4 (shown), lv=hidden evolution level, c=cells, cd=seconds (0 = passive), once=fires once below 50% HP. on: what a trigger does (dmg, el, crit, critx, st{status:stacks}, shield, heal, haste[v,s], charge=seconds given to adjacent items, ramp=+dmg per own trigger this fight). adj: buffs to touching items with that tag. all: buffs to every item with that tag. pass: hero stats while in the pack (hp, regen, thorns, shield, income). sp: special hook in code. evo: what two copies placed side by side become at night.

burn.d: Deals its stacks as damage every second, then loses 1 stack.

poison.d: Deals 0.4 damage per stack every second. Never wears off.

thorns.d: When you are hit, deal 80% of its stacks back to the attacker as Magic damage (max 25 stacks). Ignores elemental resistances.

bleed.d: Each time the bleeding side uses an item it takes 0.6 damage per stack, then loses 1 stack. Ignores Armor and Shield.

soaked.d: Per stack: items charge 2% slower and Magic damage taken +5% (max 10 stacks).

ember.d: Fire blades that hit harder the longer the fight burns.
comp: Core: two Ember Swords evolve into a Flame Saber; Smith Hammer + Ember Sword fuse into a Magma Hammer.
🌋 Inferno: Fire Gems turn touching weapons into Fire damage and stack Burn; the Cinder Heart detonates it at 15. Masterwork: Sunforge Crown.
⚒️ Forgeblade: fewer, bigger weapons; the Anvil Sigil makes every swing hit harder. Masterwork: Worldsplitter.
🪶 Phoenix: Fire items heal you and you rise again once per fight. Masterwork: Phoenix Ascendant.

res.d: +1 Heat each time a Fire item triggers. Weapons deal +4% damage per Heat (max 35%).

ult.d: Deals 30 + 3 per Heat Fire damage, 8 Burn, and heals you for 12.

venom.d: Poison that never stops climbing, and potions that keep you standing.
comp: Core: Venom Vial + Mortar fuse into a Toxic Draught; Herb Pouches keep you alive while Poison works.
🦠 Plague: Poison never wears off. Pile it on with Viper Flasks and the Rot Idol. Masterwork: Mother of Rot.
🪙 Transmuter: keep your gold, the Gilded Scale turns it into damage. Masterwork: Philosopher's Engine.
💣 Bombardier: Bombs charge faster and burn. Masterwork: Doomsday Payload.

res.d: +1 Toxin per 5 Poison applied. Poison and Burn deal +2.6% damage per Toxin.

ult.d: Adds half the enemy's Poison again (+50%) and heals you for 12.

tinker.d: Gadgets that charge each other into a storm of tiny hits.
comp: Core: Batteries next to guns make them fire more often; Spark Pistol + Gear Box fuse into an Arc Repeater.
🔋 Overclock: chain Charge so everything fires nonstop. Masterwork: Perpetual Core.
🛠️ Arsenal: fill the pack with Turrets; each one makes the others stronger. Masterwork: Siege Walker.
⚡ Voltmaster: fast Shock hits charge up chain lightning. Masterwork: Storm Engine.

res.d: +1 Gear per 2 Mech triggers. All items charge 2% faster per Gear (max 40%).

ult.d: Every item charges fully, then +50% Haste for 4 seconds.

warden.d: A wall of stone and thorns that punishes every hit.
comp: Core: Stone Shield + Moss Charm fuse into a Living Shield. Easy to start: block first, hit back later.
🌵 Thorns: stack Thorns and let every enemy hit hurt itself. Masterwork: Bramble Bastion.
⛰️ Colossus: huge Max HP that turns into big strikes. Masterwork: Titan Heart.
🌋 Earthshaker: Melee hits stun the monster's items. Masterwork: Tectonic Maul.

res.d: +1 Guard per 12 Shield gained. Each Guard deals 0.65 damage back when you are hit.

ult.d: Deals damage equal to 3 times your Shield.

rogue.d: High-speed blades and lethal critical strikes that bleed enemies dry.
comp: Core: fast daggers crit and stack Momentum; Throwing Knives and Krises make the enemy Bleed. Rogue Dagger + Throwing Knife fuse into Twin Daggers.
🩸 Crimson Executioner: stack Bleed and heal from it. Masterwork: Bloodletter.
🏹 Phantom Marksman: keep pack tiles empty to evade and power up Ranged knives. Masterwork: Phantom Volley.
💀 Assassin: open with a crit and finish weakened enemies. Masterwork: Reaper's Edge.

res.d: +1 Momentum every critical hit. Weapons gain +3% crit chance (max 45%) and +5% crit damage (max +80%) per Momentum.

ult.d: Evade the next attack; your next weapon hit is a 250% critical hit that applies 6 Bleed.

weaver.d: Cosmic spells and mana engines that obliterate foes from afar.
comp: Core: Spells build Mana, which powers all Magic damage; Mana Crystals make touching Spells charge faster. Rune Tome + Mana Crystal fuse into an Astral Codex.
❄️ Frostbinder: Water Spells Soak the enemy and hit harder. Masterwork: Absolute Zero.
🕳️ Void Caller: Spells hit 60% harder but cost HP. Masterwork: Event Horizon.
🌠 Starcaller: every third Spell casts twice. Masterwork: Celestial Orrery.

res.d: +1 Mana each time a Spell triggers. Magic damage +2% per Mana (max 34%). Supernova spends it all.

ult.d: Spend all Mana: deal 20 + 3 per Mana Magic damage and freeze the enemy's items for 2 seconds.

inquisitor.d: Sacred swords and arcane runes that demand perfect balance between steel and spell.
comp: Core: put Runes next to swords. A sword hit charges touching Runes 15%; a Rune hit gives touching swords +3 Magic on their next swing.
🌪️ Tempest Paladin: fast blades and Shock Runes that hit harder. Masterwork: Thunder Aegis.
🌑 Dusk Knight: heavy greatswords and Blood Runes; Physical hits heal you. Masterwork: Twilight Edge.
🛡️ Templar: Shield you gain powers your next sword hit. Masterwork: Sacred Bulwark.

res.d: +1 Balance each time you switch between Physical and Magic hits. All damage +1.3% per Balance (max 22%).

ult.d: Deal 15 Physical and 15 Magic damage. If your Physical and Magic damage this fight are within 30% of each other: double damage and heal 12.

beast.d: A ferocious pack of evolving forest predators and primal nature totems.
comp: Core: Beasts in your pack attack on their own and build Ferocity. Feed them: a Wolf Pup or Hawk touching Raw Meat grows up at night; two Raw Meat make a Prime Steak for the Tiger Cub.
🦴 Apex Pack: Beasts make the enemy Bleed and pierce Armor. Masterwork: Pack Alpha.
🪘 Primal Shaman: Totems buff Beasts and every Beast attack heals you. Masterwork: World Spirit.
🐺 Packlord: every Beast makes the others stronger. Masterwork: Alpha Den.

res.d: +1 Ferocity each time a Beast attacks. Beasts charge 1.2% faster per Ferocity (max 30%).

ult.d: You heal 10 and gain 2 Shield per Beast in your pack.

corsair.d: Deep-sea leviathans and crushing tides that drown the battlefield.
comp: Core: Sea creatures build Tide and hit harder with it; every 5 Tide Soaks the enemy. Harpoons make it Bleed.
🪣 Bloodwater Frenzy: sharks and harpoons; Sea creatures speed up while the enemy Bleeds. Masterwork: Megalodon.
🦪 Siren's Abyss: puffers, eels and Water magic that shock a Soaked enemy. Masterwork: Leviathan Song.
💥 Cannoneer: Ranged guns fire free broadsides. Masterwork: Ghost Galleon.

res.d: +1 Tide each time a Sea creature attacks. Sea creatures deal +2% damage per Tide (max 50%). Every 5 Tide the enemy gets 2 Soaked.

ult.d: Deal 15 Physical + 2 Water damage per Tide (counts up to 15 Tide), freeze the enemy's items for 1.5 seconds and heal 12.

_monsters: Monster items fight for the enemy. Their damage is scaled per fight (dmg_mult) so every pack hits as hard as the day's curve says; the items decide HOW it hits (fast, poison, shields, heals). t = tier: a pack only uses tiers up to the day's rank.
_foe_pets: Hard and up: every monster (bosses too) brings one. dmg/haste/leech/shield/hp are fractions; st = statuses each of its hits puts on you (grows with the day).

tortoise.d: it starts the fight with a Shield of 10% of its Max HP

bat.d: it heals 20% of the damage it deals

snake.d: each of its hits also Poisons you

_foe_ults: Very Hard and up: monsters (not bosses) charge an Ultimate, +1 each time one of their items fires. Same keys as boss moves; statuses grow with the day.

Goblin.d: hits for 3× its attack and Burns you 5

Bandit.d: hits for 3× its attack and makes you Bleed 5

Slime.d: Poisons you 8 and heals 8% of its Max HP

Skeleton.d: a crushing blow for 5× its attack

Bandit.d: makes you Bleed: you take damage every time you use an item

Slime.d: stacks Poison on you, which never wears off

Skeleton.d: slow, but every hit is huge (Shield helps)

_boss_drops: One roll per boss kill. w = weight (higher = more common). Treasure is sell-only filler that keeps the strong drops rare.
_pets: A pet is a simple, always-on buff picked at the start of a run. Keys: hp (Max HP), crit (all items), income (gold each morning), shield (Shield at the start of each fight), haste (items charge faster), regen (HP per second), free_reroll (first reroll each day is free), ult (Ultimate needs this much less charge).

fox.d: Your first 3 shop rerolls each day are free, and +1 gold every morning.

_difficulties: Enemy HP and damage multipliers per mode, applied on top of the curve. elite: chance an extra Elite/Ambush road appears.

difficulties.d: Plain monsters. Only bosses have a skill.
Monsters bring a pet. Elites and bosses have a skill.
Pets, monster Ultimates, every monster has a skill (bosses 2).
Pets, Ultimates, 2+ skills on every monster (bosses 3+).

mech.d: Every 10s it gains a Shield of 8% of its Max HP and Burns you 2.
Every 12s it hits for 1.5× its attack and freezes your items for 1.5s.
Every 11s it hits for 4× its attack and stuns your items for 2s.
Every 7s it hatches 3 spiderlings that bite you every second. Each of your item hits kills one.
Every 9s it deals +15% damage for the rest of the fight (stacks). Kill it fast!
Every 10s a huge breath hits for 4× its attack. Have Shield ready!
Every 8s it wipes half of your Burn, Poison and Bleed off itself, heals that much and Poisons you 4.
Every 8s it holds your 2 strongest items for 5s and Soaks you 3.
Every 9s a Fire breath hits for 3.5× its attack and Burns you 6. Below half HP it breathes every 6s.

mods.d: Rerolls cost +1 gold; all gold rewards +40%.
Shock items deal +30% damage; every item is 10% slower.
Healing is halved; all your damage is +15%.

vampiric.d: heals 40% of the damage it deals

spiked.d: your item hits cut you for 8% of their damage

purifier.d: removes 30% of your Burn, Poison and Bleed on it every 5s

_rarity: Shop / loot odds per rank (days 1-3, 4-7, 8-11, 12-15, beyond) for Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic, Legendary, Unique, Mythical. Legendary and above never appear in the shop: they come from evolutions, bosses, the Cursed Altar and Masterworks.
_leveling: Win fights for EXP (xp per node kind). need = need_base + floor((level-1) / need_step) EXP per level. Every level: +hp Max HP and +dmg (fraction) damage. Every pick_every levels: choose 1 of 3 picks. Pick keys add to the same buffs pets use (hp, hp_pct, dmg, crit, haste, regen, shield).
